title: Define composable animation asset contract
summary: Defined the core AnimationAsset contract as a thin typed composition layer over semantic bundles, transformations, editable transform trees, render targets, layouts, timelines, export targets, dashboard metadata, and validation refs.

sourceRefs.summary: Decision naming composable semantic animations as KP's primary authored artifact.
Core semantic asset and selector primitives the animation contract should reference.
SemanticTransformation and definition contracts the animation contract should compose.
Sequence, parallel, annotations, and rewind phase model that should become the animation transformation tree boundary.
Renderer-neutral visual motif timeline composition that animation assets should target.
Existing frame-sequence export format that should become a consumer of sampled animation frames.
Adds the typed AnimationAsset contract, constructor, cloning, and reference validation.
Covers JSON-compatible construction and unresolved reference diagnostics for AnimationAsset.
Stores the approved composable animation asset run contract.

expectedLearning: What minimal AnimationAsset v0 fields can compile to existing semantic assets, transform trees, visual motifs, dashboard rows, and exports.
Which tutorial-card-specific names should stay as compatibility consumers rather than become the core abstraction.
How LLMs should author and decompose animation assets without directly editing renderer state.
Which laws prove animation composition, seek, and rewind before graph/programming/media consumers adopt it.
allowedWork: Define AnimationAsset as a typed contract above existing semantic asset, transformation, motif, timeline, layout, frame, dashboard, and export seams.
Migrate a small number of existing generated algebra examples into the contract as adapters or fixtures.
Keep existing tutorial-card modules as consumers until a later compatibility rename is justified.
Add law checks and dashboard/export metadata that prove the contract composes and rewinds.
disallowedWork: Do not build GIF/video encoders in this loop.
Do not rename all tutorial-card source modules as a broad mechanical churn.
Do not create a renderer-owned animation format separate from semantic asset calculus.
Do not broaden into curriculum generation or spaced repetition before the animation contract is stable.
